name: Gemma 1 7B
notes: CONTRAST RECORD, kept because Gemma 1's serving pathology is the reason Gemma 2 exists. Reading the config against Gemma 2: model_type 'gemma' not 'gemma2'; num_key_value_heads 16 equals num_attention_heads 16, i.e. plain MHA with no GQA at all; NO attn_logit_softcapping key; NO sliding_window key; query_pre_attn_scalar absent. head_dim 256 is stated explicitly. intermediate 24576. vocab 256000. kv_cache_bytes_per_token = 28 * 16 * 256 * 2 * 2 = 458752 bytes/token at bf16 — 4.3x the Gemma 2 9B figure of 344064 on almost identical parameters. That ungated, unsoftcapped, un-windowed attention is the mechanism behind Gemma 1's well-documented tendency to emit enormous logits that destabilize greedy decode: without softcapping, attention logits grow with sequence length and a small numerical difference flips the argmax. Serve Gemma 2 instead. params_b = 8.538 is the safetensors total from the unsloth mirror (8537680896); google/gemma-1-7b is gated and returned 401 so its own metadata could not be read directly. This is the one field in this record not confirmed against the vendor repo.
